newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkpetrol sells Turcas stake to Conoco unit.
newsitem.headline: Turkpetrol sells Turcas stake to Conoco unit.

text.p: Turkish Turkpetrol International Inc. will sell its 46.24 percent stake in Turkey's petroleum products and lubricants producer Turcas Petrolculuk A.S. for $65.3 million to American Conoco Inc's Turkish subsidiary Tabas Petrolculuk A.S., it said.
The company said in a statement sent to Istanbul Stock Exchange that Tabas Petrolculuk would hold an 82 percent share in Turcas' 2.03 trillion lira capital after the sale.
The payment will be made in three installments -- $40.9 million on September 9, $3 million on September 12 and $21.4 million on September 26, the statement said.
